beats.event: Lear announces he will divide the kingdom among his daughters
Goneril and Regan flatter; Cordelia will not compete
Enraged, Lear disowns Cordelia and splits her share
Kent, defending Cordelia, is banished on the spot
Edmund forges the letter that turns Gloucester against Edgar
Goneril demands Lear dismiss half his hundred knights
Regan joins her; together they strip him of all his knights
Lear rages out into the storm on the heath, unhoused
On the heath he meets Edgar disguised as mad Poor Tom
Cornwall gouges out Gloucester's eyes at his own hearth
Blinded Gloucester is turned out; led toward Dover by Edgar
Cordelia's French army reaches Britain; father and daughter reconcile
British forces defeat the French; Lear and Cordelia captured
Goneril poisons Regan; Edgar kills Edmund in trial by combat
Edmund's reprieve comes too late; Cordelia is hanged in prison
Lear enters carrying Cordelia's body and dies of grief
